hookups.source: https://www.cityoffremont.net/226/Rates ('Transient Lots: Limited to 1-month stay with sewer, water and electricity: $47 per day'), read 2026-10-22. Amperage not stated.

values.note: Mostly seasonal: the campground map numbers about 91 RV lots and highlights 17 of them as transient sites, plus 6 tent sites (92-97) and two cabins. Seasonal lots take a 5-month minimum.

sites.source: https://www.cityoffremont.net/DocumentCenter/View/2834/Campground-Map (legend 'Tent Sites' / 'Transient Sites', scanned 2025-07) + https://www.cityoffremont.net/226/Rates ('Seasonals - 5-month minimum'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 2026: Friday April 24 through Sunday October 11. Typically the last Saturday in April through the 2nd or 3rd Saturday in October.

season.source: https://www.cityoffremont.net/226/Rates ('The Campground will be open from Friday, April 24 through Sunday, October 11, 2026') + https://www.cityoffremont.net/224/Campground ('typically open from the last Saturday in April through the 2nd or 3rd Saturday in October (near the 15th)'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.cityoffremont.net/224/Campground ('A boat launching area, parking, showers and complete sanitary facilities are readily available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve with the campground office (231-924-5227) or the manager by phone or e-mail; transient stays are paid in full when booked and are limited to one month. No refunds on reservations covering a holiday. Check-in after 3 pm, check-out by noon.

booking.source: https://www.cityoffremont.net/227/Rules ('to make a reservation, you may contact the campground office at: 231-924-5227', 'TRANSIENT SITES – ... full payment is due at the time the reservation is made', 'No refunds on any reservations that covers a holiday', check-in/out) + https://www.cityoffremont.net/226/Rates ('Limited to 1-month stay'), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Fremont park on Fremont Lake (948 Cottage Grove, Fremont), 1 mi from downtown, with a playground, beach and boat launch. --Claude
summary: City pages confirm the 2026 $47/day transient rate (stored; weekly $280, monthly $850, tents $25; no resident/non-resident split), water/sewer/electric at transient lots, showers, reservations through the campground office. Added the 2026 season (Apr 24 - Oct 11), booking details, and the transient/seasonal split from the city map. Mostly seasonal: 17 of ~91 RV lots are transient (about 1 in 5, so long-stay test 4 passes); seasonals take 5 months. Note: hookups, season and booking text dropped (now in fields).
